answer: Anchor every agent to one vertex in a shared trust graph: joining the market requires locking collateral behind a single identity, and all of that agent's work accrues to that vertex alone. A sybil attacker planting a garden of fake identities only divides the same stake, gaining no extra weight, while each new identity must pay the full lock-up and earn trust from zero. A forge minting reputation for clones costs real capital and time, so flooding the market buys nothing.
